title: Clean memoized prime checker with type hints and boundary checks
diff:
@@ -1,5 +1,17 @@
 import math
 from functools import lru_cache
 
+@lru_cache(maxsize=1024)
 def is_prime(n: int) -> bool:
-    raise NotImplementedError
+    """Return True if n is prime, False otherwise."""
+    if n <= 1:
+        return False
+    if n <= 3:
+        return True
+    if n % 2 == 0 or n % 3 == 0:
+        return False
+    limit = int(math.isqrt(n))
+    for i in range(5, limit + 1, 6):
+        if n % i == 0 or n % (i + 2) == 0:
+            return False
+    return True
